name: bbox_corners_to_bounding_sphere
description: BBox::CornersToBoundingSphere scans eight corners, computes the min/max center, and uses the original fast square-root approximation for the radius.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass utility/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x452650 validates fastcall inputs in ecx/edx plus outRadius on the stack, the eight-corner min/max scan, center writes, radius-square accumulation, and the float-bit approximation `(bits >> 1) + 0x1fc00000`.
The native smoke verifies unordered corner input, computed center, and exact radius float bits produced by the approximation.
